prior_context_disclosure: Same GPT-6 family, possible latent prior project exposure, no Parnesse proposal disclosed by current handoff and no prior Parnesse verdict file opened for Stage A.
commander_identity: 5-mana Grixis political spell-copy commander taxing opponents 4 life for spells/abilities targeting your objects, optionally giving target opponents copies when you copy a spell.
natural_power_ceiling: Optimized Bracket 4 copy-first spellslinger with volatile, politically asymmetric spell-sharing, not empirically demonstrated cEDH.

strongest_challenger.reason: Cheap repeatable Wizard copy trigger vs reliable high-mana red-spell-only copying, coin-flip losses and opponent copy-sharing.

rules_checks: Spell copies created on stack generally are not cast and do not advance storm count.
Parnesse's own trigger offers optional opponent copies, not copies to controller.
Opponent copies targeting you/permanents can trigger Parnesse 4-life-or-counter protection, but not all copies target you.
Harmonic Prodigy and Wizard's Staff can multiply Parnesse triggers including opponent offer, not just tax.
Prismari can grant another storm instance to Grapeshot, but storm copies aren't cast and don't feed later storm count.
Sunken Palace can copy an ability or a spell depending on use of its mana; Parnesse triggers only on copying spells.
Mana Geyser plus Reiterate buyback needs >=7 tapped enemy lands and enough seed mana/copy effect to begin.
Krark loss returns original to hand, is not countering, and can disrupt live response.
